faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person to violate a provision of this chapter. Violators
               shall be subject to the penalties as contained in
section 1-5
of the Arvada City Code and may also be subject to civil remedies. A separate offense
               shall be deemed committed upon each day such person is in violation of this chapter
               unless otherwise provided in this chapter.
(Ord. No.
4733
, § 1, 6-15-2020)
